content.purpose: Transform a stream through several small, composable stages.
content.mentalModel: Each pipeline stage should do one clear transformation. Intermediate output can be inspected by running the pipeline only up to that stage.
syntax: grep ERROR app.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr

demonstration.command: grep ERROR app.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
demonstration.explanation: This small example isolates the main idea behind multi-stage pipelines.

remember: Each pipeline stage should do one clear transformation. Intermediate output can be inspected by running the pipeline only up to that stage.
Verify the resulting state before moving on.

tasks.instruction: Create /home/student/answers/error-counts.txt containing “3 disk” then “2 auth”, using a multi-stage pipeline.
hints: First isolate errors, then isolate the error name.
sort makes identical names adjacent so uniq -c can count them.
A final numeric reverse sort puts the largest count first.
tasks.suggestedSolution: grep '^ERROR' /home/student/lab/app.log | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | awk '{print $1, $2}' > /home/student/answers/error-counts.txt
alternateSolutions: awk '/^ERROR/{count[$2]++} END{for (name in count) print count[name], name}' /home/student/lab/app.log | sort -nr > /home/student/answers/error-counts.txt
